question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: She ___ to school every day.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: She ___ to school every day.
question.en: Fill in the blank: She ___ to school every day.

explanation.uz: Present Simple zamonida he, she, it bilan fe’lga -s yoki -es qo‘shiladi: she goes.
explanation.ru: В Present Simple с he, she, it к глаголу добавляется -s или -es: she goes.
explanation.en: In the Present Simple, verbs take -s or -es after he, she and it: she goes.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: I have ___ umbrella.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: I have ___ umbrella.
question.en: Fill in the blank: I have ___ umbrella.

explanation.uz: “Umbrella” so‘zi unli tovush bilan boshlanadi, shuning uchun “an” artikli ishlatiladi.
explanation.ru: Слово umbrella начинается с гласного звука, поэтому нужен артикль an.
explanation.en: Umbrella starts with a vowel sound, so we use the article an.

question.uz: “child” so‘zining ko‘plik shaklini tanlang.
question.ru: Выберите форму множественного числа слова “child”.
question.en: Choose the plural form of “child”.

explanation.uz: “Child” qoidaga bo‘ysunmaydigan ot: uning ko‘plik shakli “children” bo‘ladi.
explanation.ru: Child — исключение: его множественное число — children.
explanation.en: Child is an irregular noun: its plural is children.

question.uz: “cheap” so‘zining antonimini tanlang.
question.ru: Выберите антоним к слову “cheap”.
question.en: Choose the opposite of “cheap”.

explanation.uz: “Cheap” — arzon, “expensive” — qimmat degani, ular qarama-qarshi ma’noli so‘zlar.
explanation.ru: Cheap значит «дешёвый», а expensive — «дорогой»; это антонимы.
explanation.en: Cheap means low in price and expensive means high in price, so they are opposites.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: My birthday is ___ May.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: My birthday is ___ May.
question.en: Fill in the blank: My birthday is ___ May.

explanation.uz: Oylar nomi oldidan “in” predlogi ishlatiladi: in May, in June.
explanation.ru: Перед названиями месяцев используется предлог in: in May, in June.
explanation.en: We use in with months: in May, in June.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: Yesterday we ___ a great film.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: Yesterday we ___ a great film.
question.en: Fill in the blank: Yesterday we ___ a great film.

explanation.uz: “Yesterday” o‘tgan zamonni bildiradi; “see” fe’lining Past Simple shakli — “saw”.
explanation.ru: Yesterday указывает на прошлое; форма Past Simple глагола see — saw.
explanation.en: Yesterday points to the past, and the Past Simple form of see is saw.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: This book is ___ than that one.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: This book is ___ than that one.
question.en: Fill in the blank: This book is ___ than that one.

explanation.uz: Ko‘p bo‘g‘inli sifatlar “more” yordamida qiyoslanadi: more interesting than.
explanation.ru: Длинные прилагательные образуют сравнительную степень с more: more interesting than.
explanation.en: Long adjectives form the comparative with more: more interesting than.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: Look! The children ___ in the garden.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: Look! The children ___ in the garden.
question.en: Fill in the blank: Look! The children ___ in the garden.

explanation.uz: “Look!” harakat ayni paytda bo‘layotganini ko‘rsatadi, shuning uchun Present Continuous kerak: are playing.
explanation.ru: Look! показывает, что действие происходит сейчас, поэтому нужен Present Continuous: are playing.
explanation.en: Look! shows the action is happening right now, so we need the Present Continuous: are playing.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: ___ do you live? — In Tashkent.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: ___ do you live? — In Tashkent.
question.en: Fill in the blank: ___ do you live? — In Tashkent.

explanation.uz: Javob joyni bildiradi (In Tashkent), joy haqida esa “Where” bilan so‘raladi.
explanation.ru: Ответ называет место (In Tashkent), а о месте спрашивают словом Where.
explanation.en: The answer names a place (In Tashkent), and we ask about places with Where.

question.uz: “bad” sifatining orttirma darajasini tanlang.
question.ru: Выберите превосходную степень прилагательного “bad”.
question.en: Choose the superlative form of “bad”.

explanation.uz: “Bad” qoidaga bo‘ysunmaydigan sifat: bad – worse – the worst.
explanation.ru: Bad — исключение: bad – worse – the worst.
explanation.en: Bad is irregular: bad – worse – the worst.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: She ___ here since 2020.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: She ___ here since 2020.
question.en: Fill in the blank: She ___ here since 2020.

explanation.uz: “Since” o‘tmishda boshlanib hozirgacha davom etayotgan holatni bildiradi, bu Present Perfect: has lived.
explanation.ru: Since обозначает действие, которое началось в прошлом и длится до сих пор, — это Present Perfect: has lived.
explanation.en: Since describes something that started in the past and is still true, so we use the Present Perfect: has lived.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: This bridge ___ in 1990.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: This bridge ___ in 1990.
question.en: Fill in the blank: This bridge ___ in 1990.

explanation.uz: Ko‘prikni kimdir qurgan, shuning uchun o‘tgan zamon majhul nisbati kerak: was + V3 (was built).
explanation.ru: Мост кто-то построил, поэтому нужен страдательный залог в прошедшем времени: was + V3 (was built).
explanation.en: Someone built the bridge, so we need the past passive: was + V3 (was built).

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
question.en: Fill in the blank: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.

explanation.uz: Birinchi tur shart gapda “if” qismida Present Simple ishlatiladi: If it rains, we will…
explanation.ru: В условных предложениях первого типа после if используется Present Simple: If it rains, we will…
explanation.en: In first conditional sentences, the if-part uses the Present Simple: If it rains, we will…

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: I enjoy ___ books in the evening.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: I enjoy ___ books in the evening.
question.en: Fill in the blank: I enjoy ___ books in the evening.

explanation.uz: “Enjoy” fe’lidan keyin keladigan fe’l -ing shaklini oladi: enjoy reading.
explanation.ru: После глагола enjoy следующий глагол ставится в форму -ing: enjoy reading.
explanation.en: After enjoy, the next verb takes the -ing form: enjoy reading.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: They have already ___ their homework.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: They have already ___ their homework.
question.en: Fill in the blank: They have already ___ their homework.

explanation.uz: “Have”dan keyin fe’lning uchinchi shakli (V3) keladi: do – did – done, demak “done”.
explanation.ru: После have нужна третья форма глагола (V3): do – did – done, значит done.
explanation.en: After have we need the third form (V3): do – did – done, so the answer is done.

question.uz: Pishgan pomidor qanday rangda bo‘ladi? Inglizcha so‘zni tanlang.
question.ru: Какого цвета спелый помидор? Выберите английское слово.
question.en: What colour is a ripe tomato?

explanation.uz: Pishgan pomidor qizil bo‘ladi, inglizchada qizil — “red”.
explanation.ru: Спелый помидор красный, а «красный» по-английски — red.
explanation.en: A ripe tomato is red.

question.uz: Qaysi hayvon “mu-u” deb ovoz chiqaradi? Inglizcha so‘zni tanlang.
question.ru: Какое животное говорит «му-у»? Выберите английское слово.
question.en: Which animal says “moo”?

explanation.uz: Sigir “mu-u” deydi; inglizchada sigir — “cow”.
explanation.ru: «Му-у» говорит корова, а корова по-английски — cow.
explanation.en: A cow says moo.

question.uz: Ingliz alifbosida “C” harfidan keyin qaysi harf keladi?
question.ru: Какая буква идёт после “C” в английском алфавите?
question.en: Which letter comes after “C” in the English alphabet?

explanation.uz: Ingliz alifbosi shunday boshlanadi: A, B, C, D, E…
explanation.ru: Английский алфавит начинается так: A, B, C, D, E…
explanation.en: The English alphabet starts like this: A, B, C, D, E…

question.uz: “big” so‘zining antonimini tanlang.
question.ru: Выберите слово, противоположное по значению “big”.
question.en: What is the opposite of “big”?

explanation.uz: “Big” — katta, “small” — kichik; ular qarama-qarshi ma’noli so‘zlar.
explanation.ru: Big — «большой», small — «маленький»; это противоположности.
explanation.en: Big and small have opposite meanings.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: one cat, two ___
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: one cat, two ___
question.en: Fill in the blank: one cat, two ___

explanation.uz: Ko‘pchilik otlarning ko‘pligi oxiriga -s qo‘shish bilan yasaladi: cat — cats.
explanation.ru: Множественное число большинства существительных образуется с помощью -s: cat — cats.
explanation.en: Most nouns form the plural by adding -s: cat — cats.

question.uz: Gapni to‘ldiring: I ___ a pupil.
question.ru: Заполните пропуск: I ___ a pupil.
question.en: Fill in the blank: I ___ a pupil.

explanation.uz: “I” bilan “to be” fe’li “am” shaklida keladi: I am.
explanation.ru: С местоимением I глагол to be имеет форму am: I am.
explanation.en: With I, the verb to be becomes am: I am.
